Steve Smith Surpasses Joe Root in Test Cricket Catches

Australian cricketer Steve Smith has become the fielder with the most catches in Test cricket history, surpassing England's Joe Root. Smith achieved this milestone during the match between South Africa and Australia, where Australian bowlers dominated the South African batsmen. Smith himself took the most catches in the match, breaking Root's previous record.
